title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GetOperationPropertyInput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GetOperationPropertyInput. This class specifies the object/datatype property of an instance from which data is going to be retrieved by indicating the name of the object/datatype property. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GetOperationPropertyInput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

obtainInputForProperty.description: Property. It identifies the attribute of an instance (COSEM object) of a class from which the data is going to be obtained. The value of this property conforms to an object property or datatype property of SAREF4GRID.
